build.prerequisites: JDK 21, Android SDK platform/build tools 35; set JAVA_HOME and ANDROID_HOME. Existing package-lock dependencies retained.
build.signing: Local debug signing only. APK signature verification passed (v1/v2). Not Play Store or Production distribution.
build.release_guard: Shared Gradle UAT gate refuses release tasks and validates product, app id, HTTPS origin and embedded bundle manifest. Release dry-run correctly refused.
build.environment: Dedicated native-uat build ignores environment files and does not embed company, business slug or auto-login. Original Takeaway is the unchanged default when FCS_POS_PRODUCT is absent.

implemented: Separate Android source directories and dedicated product entry points, not the shared ERP App router.
Employee business-code login, secure-storage session, signed branch selection, role-aware navigation; reject Super Admin, QA and wildcard-permission sessions.
Client product/context and offline-write guards supplement existing server authentication and permissions; no new server-enforced mobile-specific claims are claimed.
Retail routes reuse existing POS, barcode intake, transfer and SKU report screens with existing permissions.
Restaurant routes reuse POS, tables, customer QR, order center, session detail/checkout and kitchen screens with existing permissions.
Scoped Counter pairing and Bluetooth printer selection; native printer copy handles revoked permission explicitly without changing the original Takeaway plugin.
Restaurant customer QR uses public UAT origin rather than the local Android WebView origin.
Android Back minimizes only after confirmation; explicit navigation warns to park the active bill first.

Restaurant paid-order online recovery persists exact payload and client order id securely before sending; changed-payload retry, unrelated mutations, branch switch and logout blocked while unresolved. Existing server idempotency is reused; offline success is never inferred.

verification.both_android_debug_assemble_unit_task_li: passed; generated unit tests are build checks, not transaction acceptance
verification.targeted_mock_browser_cases: Retail: 2 passed, Restaurant-only case skipped. Restaurant: 3 passed. Recovery case rechecked after pending-write guard change.
verification.browser_scope: Login without auto-login; signed product branch selection; reload session; forbidden routes; reject superuser; wrong-context and offline-write guards; 390/820/1280 viewport containment; lost-response retry uses identical client id.
verification.uat_read_only_preflight: Both API origins returned CORS allowance for https://localhost on login OPTIONS. No live login, sale or other business writes performed.
verification.warnings: Existing large web bundles and Android dependency/deprecation warnings remain. APK verifier reports v1 META-INF metadata warnings; v2 signature verifies.

Test actual scoped employee accounts and Counter pairing against UAT, catalog/photo URLs and transaction round trips for both products.
Finish rejected/ambiguous payment operator resolution. Current recovery retains unresolved requests conservatively; no discard button or override is provided.
Verify native cart/hold persistence and generic POS, table checkout, refund, shift close recovery across force-close, timeout and restart. No full native transactional acceptance is claimed.
Approve printer models; physically test Thai receipt, paper-out, disconnect/reconnect, cash drawer, camera, scanner and Android Back/keyboard/orientation.
Finalize distinct branded icons/splash and app update distribution; current generated icons are placeholders.
Prepare backed-up release keystores, Production environment and per-product rollout approval after physical acceptance.
next_work: Finish the remaining route and transaction-recovery integration, then distribute the UAT candidates for physical acceptance. Retail may pass its gate before Restaurant. Do not mark all eight planned work items complete based on these builds.
